messages:
lena_am: Quick escalation  PulsePoint Health (acct PP-120) ran an experimental quantization pass that caused token duplication during a bulk ingest. They were billed INV-2026-6220 for $13,200 in overages and are asking for a one-time credit and a one-month rate lock for their next billing cycle while they validate their pipeline. Can finance approve?

rahul_sales: Theyre a key regional account in trials. The duplicate-tokens bug was our model conversion recommendation, though customer triggered the run. Theyre likely to convert if we move fast. Recommend full credit + rate lock as a retention play.

max_revops: Note: rate locks are sensitive; any concession to pricing needs legal and a clear clause (one-time, limited duration). Credits > $10k require deal desk approval and exec sign-off.

sophia_fin: Need facts: invoice posted? billing window? Is this truly one-off? Also need GL code for credit and wording for NetSuite memo.

lena_am: Invoice posted 2026-07-08 for Jun 28Jul 4. SRE confirms duplicated tokens from the quantize pipeline; customer followed our public guide and used a script we linked. Seems one-off but higher risk because they plan nightly imports.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-221 created for $13,200. Approval status: pending finance + deal desk.

sophia_fin: I can provisionally approve the credit on the condition we: 1) limit credit to INV-2026-6220, 2) include legal amendment language that the rate lock (if approved) is a single 30-day pricing hold at their current committed rate, and 3) record GL 7302. If exec signs, finance will post CM.

rahul_sales: One-line business case: "PulsePoint is a strategic trial converting to Dedicated; credit and short rate hold reduce churn risk and protect ~$160k ARR pipeline."

cfo_oliver: Given the ARR impact, Ill approve the $13,200 credit and permit a single 30-day rate lock. Legal must sign the amendment and RevOps should add language preventing precedent. Marking CFO-approved exception.

max_revops: I'll draft amendment: 
```
Amendment: Redwood Inference will issue a one-time credit of $13,200 applied to INV-2026-6220 and grant a single 30-day rate lock at the customer's existing committed price. This is a one-time customer accommodation and does not modify standard pricing, nor create precedent for future invoices.
```

sophia_fin: Confirmed CFO approval. I'll route CM-2026-221 for posting once amendment is countersigned and will use GL 7302 (Customer Credits - Exceptions). NetSuite memo will reference CFO exception and attach amendment.

lena_am: Thanks all. I'll notify PulsePoint and coordinate countersignature. Billing: please post CM after countersign.

billing-bot: Action items: attach amendment to CM-2026-221, post credit upon countersignature, update NetSuite memo.

lena_am: Resolving thread once CM posts. Appreciate the quick help :tada:
